item.title: Live Updates: Lebanon-Israel Cease-Fire Goes Into Effect
item.summary: It was unclear if the agreement between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the Lebanese government was being honored. Hezbollah, the Iranian-backed militia, acknowledged the temporary truce but did not say if it would abide by it.

item.title: Why China Isn’t Pushing Iran to Accept U.S. Demands to End War
item.summary: Despite the economic risks from the war, Beijing will likely stick to a hands-off approach. It is wary of being entangled in a conflict it opposed and has little sway over.

item.title: Pope Leo, Amid Standoff With Trump, Says ‘Woe to Those Who Manipulate Religion’
item.summary: For days, Pope Leo XIV has attracted criticism from President Trump and his allies for refusing to back the war in Iran. On Thursday, he reiterated his calls for peace.

item.title: Russian Strikes Kill at Least 15 in Ukraine in Biggest Attack in Months
item.summary: Moscow is again ramping up missile and drone attacks on civilian targets, dispelling any notion that a temporary cease-fire for Orthodox Easter might become more lasting.

item.title: Bahrain Charges Intelligence Officer in the Death of a Detainee
item.summary: The officer was charged with assault leading to death, in the case of a man who was accused by Bahraini authorities of espionage during a domestic crackdown tied to the war in Iran.

item.title: Despite Cease-Fire, Iran’s Hackers Haven’t Logged Off
item.summary: Tehran’s digital warriors have continued to seek ways to gain an advantage in the conflict in a new phase of cyberspace operations.

item.title: U.S. Completes Handover of Military Bases in Syria
item.summary: The transition signals the end of a formal U.S. military presence in Syria for the first time in more than a decade.

item.title: 10-Day Cease-Fire Between Israel and Lebanon Goes Into Effect
item.summary: The pause in the fighting between Israeli forces and Iranian-allied Hezbollah militants may help smooth the way to a peace deal between the U.S. and Iran.

item.title: Got $100 Million? Ukraine Has Just the Fertilizer Plant for You.
item.summary: An effort to privatize the facility is a key test of whether Kyiv can overcome concerns about Russian attacks and corruption to attract foreign investment.

item.title: Pakistan Looks to Play Peacemaker Between U.S. and Iran, Again
item.summary: After talks in Islamabad last weekend led to a two-week cease-fire, Pakistan is offering to host another round in an attempt to sustain continuing peace efforts.
